name: Riso print
summary: A risograph print on uncoated paper: near-black key plate plus one or two spot inks, halftone fades, hard offset stickers and a slight misregistration on every title.
best_for: punchy numbers with one strong claim
avoid_for: dense research summaries that need a quiet serif voice
photo-led stories where the photo must keep its original colours

rules.grid: Single column on 80 px margins. Titles hang from the top of the frame; a heavy 4 px ink rule carries the footer (source left, handle and folio right, in mono). Covers and the CTA put the logo top-left, small.
rules.type: Condensed heavy grotesque (Archivo at width 62 to 75, weight 800 to 900) in uppercase for titles, stat numerals, quotes and the CTA; a sturdy grotesque (Schibsted Grotesk) for body, list items and chart text; a monospace (IBM Plex Mono) for sources, captions, folios and chart headings. Every display line gets the misregistration: a zero-blur text-shadow a few px off, in the second ink at partial opacity.
rules.density: One idea per slide. About half the slides are calm (plain paper, one huge numeral or a poster quote), the other half dense (chart, list, screenshot) and carry a halftone fade in the top margin. A text slide is a title plus at most 55 words.
rules.accent: Two spot inks. The first brand colour is the misregistration drum (title ghosts, offset shadows of plates); the contrast-safe accent roles do the rest: highlight under ink words (accent-fill, 7:1), highlighted bar and URL underline (accent-mark), list stickers. Without a brand the drums are fluorescent pink and federal blue.
rules.photo: Shown whole (contain) on a halftone mat inside a 3 px ink frame with a hard offset shadow in the second ink. The photo is printed as a key-plate duotone: grayscale, multiplied over the dotted mat so its highlights take the screen.
rules.texture: Paper grain on every slide (SVG feTurbulence mask, about 7 %), mottled grain on the ink plate, halftone dot fades (CSS radial-gradient rows of decreasing dot size) only in margins and on mats, never under body text above 10 %.

layouts.cover-a: Poster: logo top-left, a halftone fade bleeding from the top edge, the title stacked huge in condensed uppercase with its misregistered ghost. With a photo: the title tops the page, the photo plate (halftone mat, offset shadow) and the standfirst share the bottom row.
layouts.cover-b: Plate and sticker: the photo plate (or a big halftone disc when there is none) fills the upper part, the title sits under it and its accent words become a tilted sticker with an ink border and a hard offset shadow.
layouts.text: Title stacked large from the top, body in the grotesque below a heavy ink rule; accent words of the body on a fluorescent highlight.
layouts.list: Title, then items separated by ink rules; numbered items carry square sticker numerals (accent fill, ink border, hard shadow).
layouts.stat: Calm poster: one huge condensed numeral with its offset ghost, the label in condensed uppercase, a context line under a heavy rule.
layouts.chart: Title, a mono chart heading over a rule, bars in solid ink and the highlighted bar in the accent with a hard ink offset.
layouts.quote: Calm poster: the quote set in condensed uppercase with oversized marks in the second ink, attribution in mono under a short rule.
layouts.media: Title over a matted photo or a browser-framed screenshot drawn as a sticker (ink border, hard shadow), numbered annotations as square stamps.
layouts.logos: Title, then logos in ink on a quiet row, a halftone fade in the margin.
layouts.visual: Title over a bespoke SVG drawn in ink with one accent fill, offset ghost on the accent shapes.
layouts.cta: Logo top-left, the action set huge in condensed uppercase, the URL as an ink-bordered sticker with a hard shadow, the standfirst under it.
